translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Daawite Israa'eeliyaaninne Yihudaan Kaateteedda
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Israa'eeliyaa Asay ubbay ittippe Kebroonan de'iyaa Daawitakko shiik'iide, «Nuuni ne suutsanne ne ashuwaa.

Kase Saa'ooli kaatiyaa gidiide de'iyaa wodekka, Israa'eeliyaa asaa olaw kaaletseeddawe neena. Med'inaa Goday ne S'oossay neena, ‹Ta asaa Israa'eeliyaa neeni heemmana; unttunttu bollakka neeni kaatetana› yaageedda» yaageedda.

Hewaa diraw, Israa'eeliyaa c'imatuu ubbay Kaatiyaa Daawitakko Kebroone katamaa yeeddino; I unttunttunna Kebroonan Med'inaa Godaa sintsan k'aalaa c'aak'uwaa c'aak'k'eteedda. Med'inaa Goday Sammeela baggana haasayeedda k'aalaadan, Daawite Israa'eeliyaa bolla kaatetanaaddan unttunttu Aa okkeeddino.
Daawitenne Israa'eeliyaa Asay ubbay Yerusaalame katamaa beeddino. He wode Yaabuusa asatuu he sa'aan de'iyaa diraw, he katamay Yaabuusa geetettee.
Yaabuusa asatuu Daawita, «Neeni ha katamaa gelanaw ubbakka danddayakka» yaageeddino. Gidooppenne, Daawite S'iyoonen de'iyaa unttunttu geesatuwaa oyk'k'eedda; S'iyoone Daawita Katamaa geetetteedda.
Daawite bare olanchchatuwaa, «Yaabuusa asatuu kaseti oliyaa ooninne ola gadaawaa gidanawaa» yaageedda. S'aruuyi na'ay Yoo'aabe kaseti biide oleedda; yaatiide gadaawaa gideedda.
Daawite he geessuwaan de'eedda; hewaa diraw, he katamay Daawita Katamaa geetetteedda.
Daawite Miilloppe doommiide, he katamaa zaaretsiide kees's'eedda; atteeda katamaa k'ay Yoo'aabe zaaretsiide kees's'eedda.
Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'inaa Goday aanana de'iyaa diraw, Daawite min minniide beedda.
Daawita Asatuwaa Minotaa

Daawita asatuu minotuu hawaappe kaalliide s'aafetteeddino. Med'inaa Goday Israa'eeliyaabaa haasayeeddawaadan, Daawite kaatetana mala, ha asatuu Israa'eeliyaa asaana gidiide, loytsi maaddeeddino. K'ay Aa kawutetsaakka miniseeddino.

Daawita asatuu minotuu hawaappe kaalliide s'aafetteeddawantta. Unttunttuppe heezzatuu loytsi eretteeddawantta. Heezzatuwaappe koyruu Hakimoonappe yeedda Yaashobi'aama; Yaashobi'aami itti gede olan heezzu s'eetu asaa bare tooraan wod'eedda.
Heezzu mino asatuwaa giddon Aa kaalliide de'iyaawe Ahoohiyaa Dooddo na'aa El"aazara.

Piliss's'eema asatuu olettanaw Pasddaamima giyaa sa'aa shiik'eedda wode, El"aazare Daawitana ittippe de'ee. Israa'eeliyaa olanchchatuu Piliss's'eema asatuwaa sintsaappe bak'atiyaa wode, El"aazare banggaa shooyk'an de'ee. Inne Daawitenne shoyk'aa gidduwaan ek'k'iide, Piliss's'eema asatuwaana oletteeddino. Med'inaa Goday wolk'k'aama s'oonuwaa immiide, unttunttu ashsheeda.
Piliss's'eema olanchchatuu Rafayma Wombban dunkkaaneedda wode, hattamu kaappatuwaappe heezzatuu Daawite de'iyaa Adulaama gonggoluwaan de'iyaa zaallaakko yeeddino.
He wode Daawite geessuwaa giddon de'ee; Piliss's'eema olanchchatuu c'uguu Beeteleheemen de'ee.
Daawite haatsaa ushanaw amottiide, «Beeteleeme katamaa penggiyaa miyiyaan de'iyaa pulttuwaa haatsaappe taana ooni ushshanddeeshsha!» yaageedda.

Heezzu mino asatuu Piliss's'eema asatuu dunkkaaneedda sa'aa pini biide, Beeteleeme katamaa penggiyaan de'iyaa pulttuwaappe haatsaa duuk'k'iide, Daawitaw aheeddino. Shin Daawite ushennaan is's'eedda; I he haatsaa Med'inaa Godaa sintsan tigeedda.

«Hawaa ushanawe taappe haakko! Barenttu shemppuwaa olettiide beedda ha asatuwaa suutsaa taani ushoo? Ayaw gooppe, unttunttu barenttu shemppuwaa aatsi immiide, haatsaa aheeddino» yaageedda. Hewaa diraw, Daawite he haatsaa ushibeenna. He heezzu mino asatuu hewaa ootseeddino.
Yoo'aaba ishay Abishaayi heezatoo kaappuuwaa. I bare tooraan heezzu s'eetu asatuwaa olettiide wod'eedda. Yaatiide ikka hara heezzatuwaadan eretteedda.
I laa"entso heezatuwaappe aad'd'i bonchchetteedda asaa; I unttunttoo kaappo gideedda. Shin I he koyro heezzatuwaana k'ara gidena.

K'abs's'i'eelappe yeedda Yoodaahe na'ay Banaayi mino asaa; mino oosatuwaa ootseedda. I laa"u eretteedda Moo'aabe gadiyaa asatuu wod'eedda. K'ay shachchay dareedda itti gallassi ollaa giddo geliide, gaammuwaa wod'eedda.

Banaayi geesay ichcheshu wad'aa gakkiyaa Gibs'e gade bitaniyaa adussa wod'eedda. Gibs'e bitaniyaa kushiyan shemayinniyaa wonddarashiyaa keeshshaa tooray de'ee; shin Banaayi gatimaa oyk'k'iide, bitaniyaakko beedda. He bitaniyaa kushiyaappe tooraa wotsi akkiide, Aa tooraan Aa wod'eedda.
Yoodaahe na'ay Banaayi hawantta ootseedda. Aa suntsaykka he heezzatuwaadan eretteedda.
I hattamatuwaa giddon daro bonchchetteedda; shin I heezzatuwaana gujjetena. Daawite Aa barena naagiyaa olanchchatoo kaappuuwaa keseedda.
Mino asatuu Yoo'aaba ishaa Asaaheela, Beeteleheemeppe yeedda Dooddo na'aa Elihanaana,
Haroodappe yeedda Shammoota, Piloonappe yeedda Helees'a,
Tak'o"appe yeedda Ik'k'eesha na'aa Ira, Anatootappe yeedda Abi'eezera,
Huushappe yeedda Sibbakaaya, Ahoohiyaa Ilaaya,
Nas'oofappe yeedda Maahiraaya, Nas'oofappe yeedda Ba'aana na'aa Heleeda,
Biiniyaama gadiyaan de'iyaa Gib'aa katamaappe yeedda Ribaaya na'aa Ittaaya, Pir"aatoonappe yeedda Banaaya,
Ga'aasha Zanggaaraa matappe yeedda Huraaya, Aarabappe yeedda Abii'eela,
Baahiruumappe yeedda Azimaaweeta, Sha'albboonappe yeedda Eliyaahiba,
Giizoonappe yeedda Hasheema, Haaraarappe yeedda Shaage na'aa Yoonataana,
Haaraarappe yeedda Sakaara na'aa Ahi'aama, Uura na'aa Elifaala,
Makeerappe yeedda Hefeera, Piloonappe yeedda Akiiya,
K'armmeloosappe yeedda Hes'ira, Ezbbaaya na'aa Naa'iraaya,
Naataana ishaa Yuu'eela, Haagira na'aa Mibihaara,
Amoonappe yeedda S'elek'a, S'aruuyi na'aa Yoo'aaba ola miishshaa tookkiyaa Ba'erootappe yeedda Naahiraaya,
Yatira yara gidiyaa Ira, Yatira yara gidiyaa Gaareeba,
Hiitiyaa Uuriyoona, Ahilaaya na'aa Zabaadanne
Roobeela zariyaa gidiyaa Shiiza na'aa Adiina. I Roobeela zaratuwaa kaappuuwaa; aanana ittippe hattamu asatuu de'iino.
Hara mino asatuu k'ay Maa'ika na'aa Hanaana, Mitaanappe yeedda Yoshafaas'a,
Ashttaarappe yeedda Ooziyaana, Aaro'eerappe yeedda Hotaama naanaa Shamaa'anne Yi'i'eela,
Shiimira na'aa Yidi'eelanne Aa ishaa Tiis'appe yeedda Yooha,
Mahaawaappe yeedda Eli'eela, Elnna'aama naanaa Yiriibaayanne Yooshaawiyaa, Moo'aabe gadiyaappe yeedda Yitima,
S'ooba katamaappe yeedda Eli'eela, Yoobeedanne Ya'isi'eela.
